blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Gabriela Women’s Party Rep. Sarah Elago on Tuesday criticized the police’s remarks that the legal counsel and families of arrested protesters were not denied access, saying the arrested individuals have the right to seek legal remedies. This came after more than 300 protesters were arrested by the police in Muntinlupa City last Sunday, amid the opening of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits. Elago said they were repeatedly denied access to the arrested individuals when they visited them at Camp Bagong Diwa in Taguig City. Elago noted that the families arrived at […]...
